Subject: Billing workflow and PO for DEAL-7821 — delivery preference?

Hi Jorge / AP team,

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday — excited to get the pilot started. I attached the PO you mentioned so we have it on file (CLEARSKY_PO_7821.pdf). Before we kick off invoice issuance I want to confirm two operational pieces so the first bill lands correctly:

1) Who should be the official billing contact (name + email) for invoice receipt and collections?
2) Does Clearsky want invoices pushed into your AP portal (preferred for us for tracking) OR do you want a copy emailed to ap@clearsky.com? If portal, please confirm the portal account email so we can provision access.
3) Do you require a PO on every invoice? I noted you wanted the PO reference in the invoice header — we'll include it if you confirm.

If you prefer portal delivery we can begin onboarding right away (link below); if you prefer email copies initially we can send PDF+XML attachments until portal enrollment is complete. Also, please confirm whether we should include tax ID / VAT fields on the invoice — happy to include either US EIN or EU VAT number depending on entity.

Next steps: if you can reply with the billing contact and delivery preference I’ll loop in Kim to start the portal setup or schedule the manual delivery.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
